scheme_name: Advance / High Skill Training Component of the Development of Industries Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must possess the educational qualification prescribed by the Training Units/Institutions
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry or have continuously resided there for the past three years
benefits_summary: Selected candidates receive a monthly stipend (₹2,500 for Higher Secondary/ITI or ₹3,000 for graduates/engineers), a one‑time travel allowance, and the training fees and accommodation charges are covered by the scheme.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
